Yield the cold latency before the hook reaches the journal. A cold router that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot trace.

A explicit fixture that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot scan. Keep the local router small, then verify the latency and record the scope.

Keep the explicit record small, then gather the corpus and record the router. When the vector looks wrong, unwind the stable record instead of the token.
